description: This file defines the WidgetController class in PHP, part of the Goteo project's web application. It handles actions related to project widgets, including displaying project details and wall of friends features.

classes.name: WidgetController
classes.description: A controller class managing widget-related actions for projects within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, setting database replica, cache, and theme.

methods.name: projectAction
methods.description: Handles displaying details for a specific project by ID, throws exception if project not found.

methods.name: wofAction
methods.description: Handles the Wall of Friends widget display for a project, throws exception if wall cannot be generated.
